stem: Iron is a transition metal in Group 8 of the Periodic Table.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain why iron has variable oxidation states.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Complete the shorthand electronic configurations of $\text{Fe}$ and $\text{Fe}^{3+}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
An aqueous solution of $\text{Fe(NO}_3\text{)}_3$ contains the complex $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_6]^{3+}$.

When solutions of $\text{KSCN(aq)}$ and $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_6]^{3+}\text{(aq)}$ are mixed, a colour change is observed. The red complex $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_5\text{SCN}]^{2+}$ forms.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the coordination number of $\text{Fe}$ in $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_6]^{3+}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
The H-O-H bond angle in water is $104.5^{\circ}$.

Suggest the H-O-H bond angle in $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_6]^{3+}$.

Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Explain why iron complexes are coloured.

parts.label: (b)(v)
parts.text:
Aqueous solutions of complexes $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_6]^{3+}$ and $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_5\text{SCN}]^{2+}$ are different colours.

Explain why these complexes are different colours.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Table 3.1 gives values for the stability constants, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of different complexes of iron.

Table 3.1

| complex | stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_5(\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4)]^{2+}$ | $5.90 \times 10^{1}$ |
| $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_5\text{SCN}]^{2+}$ | $1.30 \times 10^{2}$ |

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
$[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_5(\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4)]^{2+}$ can form when $\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4$ reacts with $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_6]^{3+}$.

Write an equation for this reaction.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Write an expression for $K_{\text{stab}}$ of $[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_5\text{SCN}]^{2+}$ and give its units.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Use the stability constant data in Table 3.1 to calculate the value of the equilibrium constant, $K_{\text{c}}$, for the following equilibrium.

$$[\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_5(\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4)]^{2+} + \text{SCN}^- \rightleftharpoons [\text{Fe(H}_2\text{O)}_5\text{SCN}]^{2+} + \text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^-$$
